About

I’m Mohan Gude, an independent game developer and gameplay / C++ programmer. I publish my games as Monu Games and study at DigiPen.

I’ve released Deep Space Cache, Keyclash, Popup.exe, and A Game About Scoring 1,000,000,000,000 Points on Steam. I’m currently working on Universal Tidy Up and Pipplop’s Tiny Adventure.

My work includes gameplay, game AI, tools, UI/UX, and real-time graphics. I use C++, C#, Python, and GDScript, and work with Unity, Godot, Unreal Engine, and OpenGL.

For inquiries, email itsjustmonu@gmail.com.

You can also find me on itch.io, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.
